rules.statement: An action filed against more than one defendant, where some of them were alive and some had died prior to the institution of the action, is not necessarily a nullity.
rules.supporting_quote: I do not think that the same considerations apply to an action filed against more than one defendant, where some of them were alive and some had died prior to action. We have not been referred to any authority which decides that such an action is a nullity. I can see no reason why it should be a nullity, for it is surely good as against the living defendants.
